name: Tan-Studio Pickup Location for JD
author: tanstudio

sections.description:
Tan-Studio Pickup Location for JD adds a JD Express pickup shipping method to WooCommerce. Customers can choose a supported region and pickup location during checkout.

Features:

  • Pickup locations for Hong Kong and Macao from the data bundled with the plugin.
  • Configurable fixed or weight-based shipping fee and free-shipping minimum.
  • Optional copying of the pickup location into billing or shipping address fields.
  • Optional cash-on-delivery payment method for JD pickup orders.
  • Country, city and district selectors in one row, followed by a single-choice pickup list.
  • Filter pickup locations by name, address or code on classic and Blocks checkout.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible.
  • WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks support.

This version supports both classic WooCommerce checkout and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.

The plugin does not collect usage statistics or send site, store or customer data to TAN-Studio or any external service. Pickup location data is read from JSON files bundled with the plugin. A customer’s selected pickup location is stored in the WooCommerce session and with the shipping line item on the order.

JD Express and related names and marks belong to their respective owners. This plugin is an independent integration and is not endorsed by or affiliated with JD Express.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WooCommerce, then activate this plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping zones.
  4. Add “JD pickup location” to the desired shipping zone and configure its title and cost.
  5. Configure supported regions under WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > JD pickup location.
  6. Use either the classic WooCommerce checkout shortcode or WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support Checkout blocks?

Yes. The pickup selector and optional cash-on-delivery method support WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.

Does the plugin connect to an external API?

No. Pickup locations are read from JSON data bundled with the plugin. The plugin does not report installation or usage data.

Where is the selected location stored?

It is stored as metadata on the WooCommerce shipping order item and appears in order details and emails.

  • Pickup selection identified by location code.

  • Configurable shipping fees, address filling and optional cash on delivery.
